name: keycast
description: Keycast is a secure key management system for teams on Nostr.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n 'rust,web,signer' -c 'blue,green,yellow' "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:signer"
scripts.dev:signer: KEYCAST_PUBLIC_URL=${KEYCAST_PUBLIC_URL:-http://localhost:3100/api} RUST_LOG=warn,keycast_signer=debug KEYCAST_ROOT_KEY_FILE=./master.key KEYCAST_SIGNER_SOCKET=./runtime/signer.sock cargo watch -w Cargo.toml -w Cargo.lock -w core -w signer -w database/migrations -x "run --bin keycast_signer"
scripts.build: concurrently -n 'rust,web,signer' -c 'blue,green,yellow' "bun run build:api" "bun run build:web" "bun run build:signer"
scripts.test: bun run test:rust && bun run test:web
